name: blog-07
description: Horizontal scroll-snap carousel of post cards with previous and next arrow controls.

"use client" import { useRef } from "react" import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const posts = [ { tag: "Research", title: "What 1,200 support tickets say about onboarding", date: "Nov 13", read: 9, hue: "from-chart-1/50 to-chart-2/20" }, { tag: "Engineering", title: "Cutting our cold start from 2.1s to 380ms", date: "Nov 8", read: 12, hue: "from-chart-2/50 to-chart-3/20" }, { tag: "Design", title: "Dense tables that still breathe", date: "Nov 2", read: 6, hue: "from-chart-3/50 to-chart-4/20" }, { tag: "Culture", title: "Our writing guide, published in full", date: "Oct 27", read: 15, hue: "from-chart-4/50 to-chart-5/20" }, { tag: "Product", title: "Inside the redesign of recurring invoices", date: "Oct 21", read: 8, hue: "from-chart-5/50 to-chart-1/20" }, { tag: "Engineering", title: "Postgres row-level security, two years on", date: "Oct 14", read: 11, hue: "from-chart-1/50 to-chart-3/20" }, ] export default function Blog07() { const track = useRef(null) function scroll(dir: 1 | -1) { const el = track.current if (!el) return el.scrollBy({ left: dir * el.clientWidth * 0.8, behavior: "smooth" }) } return (

Tallyhall blog
